## Changes

### Native SDKs 2.10.2: [WalletAndroid#212](https://github.com/velocitycareerlabs/WalletAndroid/pull/212), [WalletIOS#202](https://github.com/velocitycareerlabs/WalletIOS/pull/202)

- Wraps the native iOS and Android 2.10.2 SDKs, which split a deep link's query before decoding it.
- A deep link that repeats `credential_types`, as Credentialing Hub depot links do, kept only one value. The wallet asked for the credential manifest with one type, so an issuer that later offered another type, such as a passport for an ID document depot, had nothing to offer. Every value now reaches the request URI.
- A `vendorOriginContext` containing `?`, `&` or base64 padding now arrives as sent. On iOS, a space sent as `+` is now a space, and an empty value reads as `""` as on Android.

No change to the React Native API.

## Backward incompatibilities

- None for links that the Credentialing Hub and the credential agent build. Some hand-written link shapes read differently, as listed in the native release notes.
